score_method: Arithmetic mean of six evidence-gated audit scores. not_applicable rows are excluded from individual weighted denominators; scores with many not_applicable rows are not a measure of full-site health.

top_fixes.impact: Mobile field LCP is 2.676 s and lab LCP is 41.5 s; slow loading can reduce usability and organic performance.
top_fixes.fix: Find the LCP element, reduce server/image/render delay, then retest mobile field and lab data.

top_fixes.impact: Mobile field CLS is 0.23, more than twice the 0.1 target; unstable layouts harm page experience.
top_fixes.fix: Reserve media/embedded-content space and eliminate dynamic header, cookie and product-card shifts.

top_fixes.impact: The homepage source has five H1 elements, weakening single-topic semantic hierarchy.
top_fixes.fix: Keep one primary H1 and demote non-primary heading markup.

top_fixes.impact: Organization schema lacks sameAs and sampled brand naming is inconsistent, reducing entity clarity.
top_fixes.fix: Standardize entity naming and add verified sameAs URLs to Organization schema.

top_fixes.impact: Indexation and sitemap processing cannot be verified without authenticated Search Console.
top_fixes.fix: Connect the correct Search Console property and review Page Indexing, sitemaps and key URL inspections.

top_fixes.impact: Only 84.6% of sampled homepage images have non-empty alt text, below the 95% target.
top_fixes.fix: Add purposeful alt text to content images and confirm decorative images intentionally have empty alt.

blockers: No authenticated Google Search Console connection
